title: ehrlich-b/composition-algebras
summary: Hurwitz's theorem (1898), dimension form: a nontrivial finite-dimensional Euclidean composition algebra over R - a unital, not necessarily associative or commutative bilinear product together with a symmetric positive-definite form whose quadratic form is multiplicative - has real dimension 1, 2, 4 or 8. R, C and H are exhibited so the class is inhabited; the classification into R, C, H and O is strictly stronger and is not part of this entry. Machine checked, not peer reviewed, no priority claim.
